Name: Mahaan
Review:
subbaraj is so damn stylish man, and SaNa oh my 😍😍😍😍. 
one thing that you’re guaranteed to get from a KS movie is pure style and GREAT cinematography, and this is another movie that didn’t disappoint. the sledgehammer fight was beautifully choreographed and it all being in one take is just 🤌🏽🤌🏽. that one scene where he goes to meet his son and in the background the train keeps going past and the orange lights flicker (it’s been months since i watched the movie forgive me) had gorgeous lighting too. 
and SaNa man, one of the best scores he’s made too Naan Naan and the main theme in general are great songs. the Mahaan album in general is one of his best works in my opinion, definitely one of the most unique in tamil cinema and is much more similar to an american hip hop album than it is to a tamil one. Dhruv was a good rapper in missing me aswell icl. 

i loved vikram’s look in this movie (the look at the start was whatever but w the long gray hair was insane) and bobby simha was fantastic in it aswell. the come up of their alcohol empire was shown dramatically, with great shots, great music, what’s not to love! simran looked beautiful too (except for the ending lol but it is what it is). and despite what a lot of ppl think i think dhruv was a pretty good actor.

but, as is with a lot of films in tamil cinema lately, the second half falters. more specifically, the third act which seems like it keeps dragging on and on and on. here were so many points where i thought the movie was gonna end but it just didn’t. i think if the ending stretch was trimmed by a bit this could be a much better film, the story became pretty poor after the focus shifted from vikram and bobby’s alcohol business to his son, and is definitely not an 8/10. the movies massively carried by the wonderful score and cinematography and general style/vibe tho.

Name: Vada Chennai
Review: even better the second time i watched it, now as a more mature viewer and a more attentive mind. the subtle details vetrimaaran includes; like the reason why samuthirakani’s Guna has that large scar across his chest. you’d think it would have a long flashback scene dedicated to it but instead is a minuscule, easy to miss part of one longer scene. that attention to detail and care for making a rich film is what makes me love this movie so much. so much going on at all times. not to mention dhanush’s outstanding acting in this; the dhanush-vetrimaaran combo produces another masterpiece of tamil cinema. although it may be several years away i’m excited for the next instalment of the franchise. as always amazing music from santosh narayanan too. also a special mention to andrea jeremiah; i was not expecting such a believable and persuading performance from her. amazing interval plot twist, the non-linear timeline is wonderful, kishore is also slowly becoming one of my favourite actors. bravo to both Dhanush and Vetrimaaran.

Name: Jigarthanda
Review:
i love this movie
subbaraj manages to find a perfect mix or humour, action, suspense, awe, practically every emotion a movie could make you feel is in this movie. i love the stunning cinematography that’s present in every KS film, the beautiful gore, the wonderful score and soundtrack by one of the greats santhosh narayanan. i don’t watch much of siddarth but he was fantastic in this film, he portrayed karthik very well. obviously you can’t talk about jigarthanda without mentioning arguably the best part of it; bobby simha. he stole the scene in every frame he was in, practically exuding evil. he was menacing and frightening for the first two hours of the movie but was able to make the audience sympathise with him nearing the end. the cameos from vetrimaaran, vijay sethupathi and bagavathi were pleasant surprises. guru somasundram was hilarious too. the only part of the film where i wasn’t in love was during the whole crybaby kumar part but that may just be because i was excited to see the violent drama karthik would create; but i have to admit it was definitely worth it for the character development that comes out of it. 

solid 9.5/10, can’t say much bad about it.

Name: Ponniyin Selvan: Part II
Review:
bro mani ratnam has literally jus created PEAK CINEMA, and there are no two ways about it. i can’t even try and make this review sound professional or sophisticated in the slightest cos this movie did INSANE things to my brain when i saw it. the first movie i’ve ever seen in imax too, that too in the leicester square imax what an experience. i do not have a clear enough mind to write about this movie in full but there are three things that in my opinion are the reason this movie is a 5/5   1) ARR - WHAT THE FUCK 
i knew this movie was gonna have an amazing score , PS1 had an absolutely gorgeous score and my personal favourite theme, the one that played when Karikalan kills Veera Pandiyan made a return which i was glad to see. but my LORD Rahman stepped it up SEVERAL notches this time round, there were so many amazing scores in this movie; the war sequence theme, the devaralan attam ’reprise’, the chinnanjiru marumarai instrumental, the list goes on and on i can’t wait for the score to come out on streaming 
2)  SPOILERS AHEAD ‘THAT’ scene, if you’ve seen the movie you’ll know which i mean 
ok the scene where chinnanjiru marumarai plays is genuinely with no doubt in my mind my FAVOURITE 10-15 minute stretch of cinema i have EVER witnessed. my FUCKING LORD it was actually perfect. vikram’s dialogues were incredible, aishwarya’s acting was unmatched, ARR’s score was intense, and my God the CAMERA WORK WAS PHENOMENAL. i can’t explain this scene properly cos i am not knowledgeable in this cinema stuff at all but i don’t think i will ever watch a sequence so masterfully crafted in cinema again. 
3) the cinematography 
mani ratnam movies are renowned for having amazing cinematography and i haven’t seen many of his movies but i have to say this was one of the most well shot movies i’ve ever seen too, even better in imax too. i’ve yet to see raavanan which i heard is MR’s best looking movie by quite a margin but this film is so beautiful to see as well
Mani Ratnam i love you

Name: La La Land
Review: gosh i’m reading this review a year later why did i used to write like such a nerd  yeah man it's magic, this film this has now cemented itself as the single greatest movie i've watched. i doubt there'll ever be a movie that i'll attach so strongly to emotionally. a long ride of ups and downs, a beautiful tale of the relationship between mia and sebastian, all laced with some of the most stunning cinematography i've seen in film, along with the most gorgeous soundtrack put to screen. chazelle created something that i don't think anyone else will be able to match for a very long time.  chazelle shows off incredible artistic vision, enabled by cinematographer linus sandgren, resulting in 2 hours of constant beautiful imagery. the colours, composition, and thought behind each scene is powerful. it’s clear that chazelle made no compromises for this film, and not a second of the movie feels wasted or unnecessary. the natural flow of the film makes it an incredibly emotional one, and the storytelling is so realistic but cinematic/dramatic at the same time. many of the interior shots in this film, especially the ones when the actor’s ’enter their flow state’ are magic.  and then the music. justin horowitz struck gold with the soundtrack for this film. the album’s firmly within my top 10 on apple music, and for good reason. there are a lot of upbeat, joyful songs that complement the energy displayed on screen perfectly (the introductory 10/15 minutes are the best example of this), whereas the more peaceful, melodic songs are highlights for me. mia and sebastian’s theme is the peak of the album, but city of stars is a very close second. ryan gosling and emma stone are actually fantastic singers too, before i added the album on apple music i thought it was someone else singing for them there’s so many more thoughts in my mind but i’m not good at writing reviews at all so i’ll end this here. this film means so so much to me  also the ending 15/20 minutes are unapologetically peak cinema. also this is the true winner of best picture  100/100

Name: Captain Miller
Review: ☹️ man, i really really wanted this movie to be great. but unfortunately i didn’t find it as appealing as i was expecting it to be , n i think it overstayed its welcome a LITTLE bit. im gonna try go thru each aspect of the film n say my thoughts on it but its 5am rn im so tired ☠️ cinematography was great, not as inspiring as the shots from rocky and saani kaayitham but definitely still some beautiful shots to look at  the performances were also fantastic, obviously dhanush’s were great and he had some pretty emotional scenes held up entirely by him , especially during the first hour of the movie, and he performs them with EASE. i heard a lot of ppl saying priyanka wasn’t that good but i believed her and her motives and ideologies entirely, (and she looked gorgeous), as was aditi balan and her sister i think it was (both also absolutely beautiful women). john kokken lowkey felt a little animated but idk this movie wasn’t really going for hyperrealism so whatever. elango had a rly good role in this movie too the music : man, im sooo conflicted about gvp. his bgm’s are always quite good but for fucks sake i HATE his music so much recently. he used to have BANGERS with mayakkam enna, aadukalam etc but i haven’t enjoyed any of his new songs in a LONG time and captain miller is no different. killer killer was almost corny cos of that english dialogue at the beginning, the song about koronar wasn’t that good either imo. the score was pretty good tho now i know this is supposed to be an action movie and much more action heavy than other tamil films but it got to a point where it was lowkey too much; especially in the second half it felt like we were moving from one set piece to the next and the stuff in between was ALMOST like filler. there was still some sort of storyline but it was not intricate in any form and the action sequences definitely took priority. however, a lot of said sequences were VERY good. my favourite shot in the trailer (all the bodies being lined up n blown up) was AMAZING in cinema, and the climax fight n temple fight were both great too. although the censor board did leave their mark on this film, the cuts were unnoticeable which is how censored films should be, not like Leo’s 15 version where it jus skips the middle of a scene.  so yeah i am a little sad i didnt enjoy it as much as i was hoping too, but its still a good film nonetheless and i hope my opinions will change on a rewatch. also fuck the censor board again because i wish Arun did make the film about LTTE as he initially intended to, but this character still felt like it had heavy inspiration from the tigers (one of the dialogues literally says these soldiers are like tigers lol) and i guess the film wouldn’t have been released if it did mention tamil tigers so whatever.  free eelam ❤️ long review sorry

Name: Dune: Part Two
Review:
potentially super mild spoilers 

“don’t try to understand it, feel it” - nolan 

i’ll be so real for half of the movie i didn’t have a clue what was going on , especially cos i didn’t enjoy the first movie much at all and i didn’t get any time to rewatch it. i had to ask soha a few q’s through out the movie to catch up but besides that the first half of the movie was really easy to get through and SUPER good looking. like i think the ‘vibe’ of watching this movie is just so good because of how epic/grand of a film it is. the way the movie shows scale is ridiculous, everything from the size of the HUGE desert and the worms and some of the machines that different houses use , they all have massive weight to them and it really engrosses you further into the world of arrakis. there’s this one scene where 3 worms come out of the ground that is just perfect on the big screen, especially on imax. i don’t wanna repeat myself but when the worms emerge out of the ground there’s this massive bass hit and it genuinely feels so exhilarating to see normal people go against these BEHEMOTHS. (when they use the thumpers to call the worms there’s a similar sound and it’s soo nice to listen to). but ngl some of my favourite scenes weren’t even the huge war scenes but some of the ground level more intimate (might not be the right word lol) fight scenes between the fremen and harkonenns. the way the fremen n paul move feels so effortless and because a lot of the fight scenes are in fog it’s SO fucking cool the way they like fade into frame. there’s this one scene near the start where a huge spaceship thing lands, (and you can tell how ridiculously large it is when there’s this wide shot with a few ppl standing by it and they’re just out of focus blobs), and the harkonenns walk out and you can see like glimpses of paul quickly slicing thru the people one at a time. YOO WAIT and then there’s this one shot where they’re all scared cos half their ppl died and then you see paul attended slowly walk into frame and then behind him the rest of the fremen and it’s just 🤤🤤 that scene was so ridiculous . idk why but this kinda felt like if kgf was actually good. there’s no dumb slow mo scenes but it feels like EVERY scene tried to be really epic but it actually succeeded , unlike in kgf where they use that shit bgm and HORROR dialogue to try make every single scene this amazing showcase of how strong rocky is, but just ends up being corny. 

i think the best part about this movie is how NICE it looks. the cinematographer is genuinely insane , but i wasn’t surprised cos the batman is 😍😍 . the audio asw, oh my GOD. i watched it at leicester square imax and bro some of the war scenes the entire seat would shake it was so hard . i wanna say something about the story but i fr didn’t understand what was happening 😭 timother chalamet was nuts tho i haven’t seen much of his work but he was REALLY believable in this film, especially in this one later scene in a temple kinda place where he’s not supposed to speak (made it vague to avoid spoiling). soon i’ll need to rewatch the first part to contextualise this movie a bit better and form a better opinion, but lowkey i think half the reason i enjoyed this movie so much was cos i watched it in imax and the amazing visuals n audio was properly emphasised. i think the movie was a teensy bit long , maybe it could’ve been cut down by like 15-20 mins. i can’t stop thinking about the audio n visuals bruh the worm riding scene was absolutely insane to witness asw this is a great movie man 

also florence pugh is SO beautiful 😍😍😍 that’s about as much as i can say ab the movie i think, defo worth watching in imax and most likely won’t be as interesting when i rewatch it at home. great cinema experience tho. i tried fasting for a day for Ramadan w soha n i regret it lmao we went to a 3pm showing and the 40 mins after 6pm was probably the hungriest i’ve been in my life my Muslim brothers you guys are so strong 

also soha watched la la land n said he rates it 8.5 LETS GOOO that guys strict as fuck w his ratings too he even cried at the ending lmao . gonna try make the rest of the guys watch it too

Name: Ford v Ferrari
Review: SPOILERS HALFWAY THROUGH! damn man , i did NOT expect this movie to be this good or to be this emotional. add this to the list of films that almost made me cry. sohaib watched la la land (my fav film) so i asked him what his fav movie was n he said this and parasite , so i figured id watch it  it’s 5.40am rn so im bare tried but man this film was genuinely amazing. everything from the end of the le mans race to the credits was just peak cinema. i don’t even know where to start the review but it might be a long one speaking more generally the cinematography was fantastic , i managed to find a beautiful 4k hdr print so i didn’t have to use the netflix one n im glad i did, because the colours in this film are so gorgeous. damon’s blue shirt is such a nice colour lmao i want a top that colour. but anyway the cinematography not just during the races but just the scenery in general is beautiful, my favourite scenes were the night time scenes where he test drives the gt40 (i think it was anyway) for the first time outside shelby international. the cars headlights n heating brakes against the city lights in an otherwise dark blue frame looked SO gorgeous, i had to pause the movie there n take a screenshot. during the races too everything looked amazing, i might be tweaking but there were a couple spots where it did look a little video gamey but they’re so minor you can basically ignore it.  the audio too was fantastic , that 7 litre sounded MEAN . but obviously besides that the sound design in general was great , you can really feel the power of all these cars and it never feels like it’s being exaggerated for the movie or overwhelming , everything is really well balanced out.  for the performances i mean they were GREAT, obviously the star of the show bale was so so good, it felt weird hearing him w a brum accent and sounding more like real life him rather than the american accent i alwuas hear him in. there were these scenes where he’d kinda go into a flow state, for example the scenes when he’s at 7000+ rpm , the audio kinda drowns out and everything slows down (which is the last thing you’d expect) and it feels like we’re just moving through space, which is EXACTLY what damon’s monologue near the beginning says and i found it INCREDIBLE how they managed to bring that monologue to screen like that. bale’s character in general was really well played , you can really picture him as Miles and you can tell he feels like he’s at one with the car . theres this one which i talk ab in the spoiler part, which imo is the greatest acted scene in the whole movie, and is one of those moments where u take a moment to be like “this is great acting” .  idk if bale has any irl interest in cars but i wouldn’t be surprised if he did cos the way he talks about them and behaves whilst driving felt SO genuine.  the guy who played leo beebe kinda looks like jonah hill but maybe im tripping but anyway he was greatly done too you just can’t help but despise him. damon was fantastic also , ESPECIALLY in the final scene man he REALLY pulled thru in that scene when he was needed most.  SPOILERS FROM NOW ON !!! but if you don’t plan on watching the movie read pls this part of the movie means quite a bit to me lol  the closing 30/40 minutes of the film was when the movie moved up from at 7.5 or so to a 8.5/9 for me, it REALLY elevated the film . when the race gets announced as a tie on that dumb technicality (i was really expecting it to be reversed somehow btw) you can’t help but feel insanely disappointed for miles, and the facial expressions that bale puts on during that critical scene only made it so much better. “you offered me the drive, not the win” man FUCK that line got me that’s when it started to get a lump in my throat. i felt so sorry for him at that moment especially when him n damon walked off into the sunset and the entire time he has this expression that on one hand shows that he is very upset but on the other shows that he’s insanely grateful for what he DID do. the scene building up to that moment was very well done too, again they had that flow state kinda scene where he was appreciating where he was at and considering henry ford’s proposal  , i genuinely couldn’t tell whether he’d slow down or not. that was one of my most memorable scenes imo. that whole sequence was masterfully done, loved every bit of it.  i went into this film completely blind not even knowing what le mans was, i thought they actually drove for 24 hours straight 😭. so i didn’t know that ken miles was going to die, so that scene in the track where he does die was a REAL shock to me. but at the same time i loved how NOT dramatised it was. i especially loved damon in that scene, where he realised that miles won’t be able to get out of the car in time. i loved the build up they did an hour or so before the first time that miles got brake face and they explained how you can survive your car blowing up like that, cos it made the pay off SO much better. at first i was like they’ll just get him out but realising how far away miles was, seeing shelby give up, it dawns on you that yes, he is going to die. that scene also was incredibly done and i loved the way they made it a huge surprise when it happened. i’m happy he died doing what he loved 💔. but that scene again had me so close to tears man. seeing the smoke build up n then that glimpse of fire, seeing everyone but damon run towards him. everything after this is when damon really shines and you can absolutely tell how much miles means to him. yeah man his death scene and everything that comes after was very very very well done.  it’s 6.10 now i can’t believe i spent half an hour writing this bro wtf 😭

Name: Maharaja
Review:
i’ve never been a good writer so i don’t know how i’m gonna make this review interesting in the slightest but i jus came out the cinema , and the drive back home today was one of the most strange / ‘bleak’ drives i’ve had leaving the cinema. anyway this is gonna be a LONG review i think so enjoy 😁😁 

i’m actually writing this in short breaks in my notes i wish letterboxd had like a draft option or something. anyway , im gonna start with the negatives of the movie , which there aren’t many of , and then i’ll try make a somewhat structured review of all the good things in the film. there’s gonna be a few paragraphs that don’t have spoilers and the rest will but ill tell u when there’s spoilers dw !! 

my only real flaws about the movie is a very generic ‘lag in second half’ criticism . but genuinely that’s the ONLY point in this movie where i felt like uhh nothings really happening right now but i think thats lowkey down to me not understanding what’s going on rather than the film being bad. and that too was only for about the 20 or so mins after the intermission, after which the movie starts to really go full speed and earn its 9* from me. 

SPOILERS for the rest of this paragraph !!! 
another ‘flaw’ which kind of becomes okay as the movie goes on is the introduction to the Kashyap-Sagar duo. they’re shown robbing these two women which is whatever but then Sagar (Sabira) sits down after the two ladies say they’ve given all they have to offer n asks “have you REALLY given everything?” n does this look at the daughter, and it’s such an UGLY feeling that really takes you out the movie for a bit. then he drags her into the room n stuff and it all feels a little too on the nose, yk? like it felt as if the director was just like “ok we need a villain, let’s just make him do the most disgusting shit ever so ppl dislike him” n i felt like there could’ve been better ways to portray how nasty this duo was. i am glad that it didn’t go too explicit for the r* scenes unlike some movies (theeran). anyway the reason i say it ‘became okay’ later on was because of all the reveals in the second half and how the centre of the entire plot revolves around the topic of r*, whereas when that scene first comes on i interpreted it as just ‘villains doing villainous shit.’

SPOILERS OVER !!! okay in terms of good things about the film there’s a LOT 

i wanna get the smaller things out of the way but the first thing that i noticed was the music, for the first 30 mins or so it’s this nice soulful , melodic theme which made the film feel pretty chill? i guess. then the music kinda takes a back seat except for the intermission when that theme from the trailer comes on during a fight scene, and it’s this really sort of hypnotising song with an old ladies voice in the background with hard hitting drums that REALLY ramp up the tension. and then it kinda dies down again before some of the best music of the entire film comes on during the final 30 mins. throughout vjs’ final narration there’s this sort of droning noise that reminds me of the fire extinguisher scene from irreversible (DISGUSTING scene btw) and it feels REALLY weird especially combined with what they’re showing you on screen n i got a warning from my apple watch cos my heart rate was high 😭.

ok what the fuck bro nobody cares i’m gonna go straight to the story which was FUCKING INSANE BRO WTF. the trailer and teaser paint the movie as a standard action movie mixed with comedy and for the first half of the movie it very much is; but oh my FUCK the tonal shift in the second half is so crazy. like the film is DARK, in a way that none of the promotional material shows. the second half is just filled with twist after twist and each one seems even more unexpected and even more emotionally powerful than the last. when you actually zoom out the storyline is super basic, man takes revenge on another man for wronging him, but the WAY they tell the story is incredible. the non-linear timeline was well executed, (although when kashyap is first introduced it’s not clear whether thats in the past or present until much later in the film, but i think that might be intentional) and the two timelines are differentiated by a younger vjs look that feels VERY reminiscent of the vjs that came up in the early-mid 2010’s through his unique story driven films (and this is another one of those films). i’m so shit at writing bro idek what i wanna say but i guess the natural next step is to talk about the final 30/45 mins and how it made me feel. (not really spoilers i’ll try to keep the details as vague as i can) 

good LORD bro the third act of this film is PERFECT. like as soon as the movie ended i really felt for a little while that it was a 10/10. the movie can’t really be described as a horror film but bro, the last time that vjs tells the ‘Lakshmi’ story, is INSANE. i said it at the end of the music para but my heart rate was getting HIGH during that scene and both the audience and maharaja make that realisation at the same and i think that elevates that scene so much. i remember my theatre all GASPING at that one moment during the narration and my boy looked at me n said “oh shit” , i was too in shock to even realise he said anything 😭. like the final narration is genuinely SCARY. AND THEN!!! they put in ANOTHER twist as they reveal how a relatively insignificant character was so pivotal to the core plot, and i just remember feeling disgusted and shocked and betrayed ALL at the same time. i didn’t acc know who this actor was before but my boy told me he’s known for more comedic roles so i can’t even imagine how that must’ve felt for someone who’s actually seen his films before. and then the ending ?!?!?!?!? O M F G 

like you’d think that the twists are over but NO !!!  the final twist is one of the most gut wrenching , DISGUSTING plot points of the whole movie and that feeling when i realise what that reveal meant was something i hadn’t experienced in a LONG time. cos when they show you that scar, you have to sort of take a moment and see EVERYTHING that happened so far in a completely different light. genuinely insane how the director managed to flip the entire film on its head like that. when they showed that footstep i kind of guessed what the final frame was gonna be and when it happened it felt SOOO satisfying. the whole ending is just so so good man. 

anyway i was gonna talk about the performances from VJS and AK but you already know that they were phenomenal and ive been waffling for so fucking long. Kashyap’s final scene and VJS’ final narration were highlights. good movie

Review:
dhanush man. what a goat.  no spoiler section  this was one of my most anticipated movies of the year , especially after i saw the INCREDIBLE cast. i wasnt a massive fan of pa paandi but its been a few years since that film and he’s acted in some of kollywood’s greatest and my favourite films since then, so i was ready for something new in raayan. and my LORD did he deliver !!!  also the biggest impact this movie had on me was making me have the biggest crush on dushara that i’ve ever had for any woman in my life. bro she is SOOOOOOOO gorgeous 😍😍😍😍😍and in the second half i literally fell in love with her everytime she was in frame first of all visually the movie was STUNNING. i saw a lot of ppl complaining that the film was ‘too colourful’ but the vibrant colour palette was RIGHT up my alley and a lot of the framing was gorgeous too. dhanush and om prakash use negative space soooo well, and there’s a good amount of visual story telling too, which i’ll talk about in the story section.  the music was already great but the score was AMAZING, and pairs so well with the cinematography. there’s certain scenes that have a horror influence to them and ARR creates this eerie ambience that builds SO much tension especially combined with the dark and very contrasty visuals. lowkey i wasn’t a fan of “odatha da” and “raayan rumble” as standalone songs but in the context of the movie they’re far better. and “oh raaya” is a super super banger!! but anyway i’m not that good at talking about the technical stuff behind movies so moving on  the story at its core is fairly basic and is unfortunately, probably the weakest point of the film. but i wanna get all the positives out of the way first before i talk ab the bad stuff. the first 30 mins of the film builds up these relationships and the way the characters exist in the world VERY well imo; in a pretty short time you have a good understanding of the quirks and history behind every character, and a few brilliant match cuts add to the visual storytelling. you can absolutely tell that this family cares a LOT for each other despite their differences, and each cast member was entirely believable. there wasn’t a single moment where a character did something that felt out of place (besides one bit that i’ll talk ab in the spoilers section) dhanush portrays the sort of ‘father figure’ trope really well and you can clearly see the care he has for his siblings and the effect that years of slaving away and keeping his head down in this world has had on him. dushara was also an amazingly done female character, which there aren’t many of in tamil cinema. looked so beautiful asw i had to say it again. every fight scene where durga and raaya are together you can see the fear they have for each others lives SOOOO well and it helps sell these relationships so much. SJS, as expected was another strong character and i looove how dhanush creates so many set ups that have really smart pay offs much later in the film.  also the interval fight scene is one of the best and most memorable i’ve seen in a LONG LONG LOOOONG time. oh my GOSH. the build up to it too?!??!? YOOOOOO😫😫😫. i love how just before that fight there’s this massive feeling of dread that again the main family portray very well, and you’re stuck with that feeling of confusion and worry and thinking “will he really do it” until we enter durai’s compound. i LOOOOOVE the way they did this fight so much. especially how you hear it before you see it, (saying that as vaguely as possible, it made the actual fight so so much better)  however, after an astounding first half, the movie does begin to falter a little after the interval. initially when i saw that the runtime was just 2.20 hours i was a little excited because a lot of tamil films have unnecessary romance and comedy tracks that don’t contribute much to the film and pad the duration for no reason, so i was happy to see such a tight run time. however, i feel like the movie deserved to be and needed to be FAR longer. the number of relationships and conflicts that they set up felt a tad overwhelming for such a short duration. raaya, durga, sekar and maybe sethu felt very well fleshed out with complete character arcs, however almost every other character felt either incomplete (prakash raj) or that they went through a transition that didn’t feel properly earned/explained. (manickam and muthu) there was also a few hints to raaya’s past that looked like they were supposed to be expanded on later in the film but never were, which makes me think that originally the film was longer but maybe was cut down in favour of a shorter runtime? idk. this was especially apparent in the closing 20/30 minutes where it felt like the movie was just rushing towards the ending as fast as possible and trying to close up every loose end in whatever way was convenient.  ok non-spoiler conclusion this is a fantastic movie and makes me very very excited for dhanush’s next directorial (not the n.e.e.k movie idc ab that also why did he name it that lmao) . part of me wants it to be a raayan pt.2 to explore this world further and help it feel less rushed but i wouldn’t mind if he wanted to make a thiruchitramblam or VIP type of movie either. it’s a very very well directed film that everyone should watch whether you’re a dhanush fan or not. i’m seriously debating going and watching it a second time just because of the first 60 ish minutes but like i said i don’t like how the movie closed off. also i bought a iphone 15 pro with my OWN salary and the battery is so fucking bad i lost like 15% jus writing this review bruh , and to make it WORSE im hearing that the 16 pro is gonna come in FUCKING rose gold bro my last 2 phones have been rose gold and pink n now i have a shit black phone i’m so mad ☹️ oh yeah why was prakash raj watching oppenheimer in the cinemas that was funny. anyway 
SPOILER TIME ‼️‼️⚠️⚠️❌❗️⁉️❌
the biggest twist of this film is the betrayal just before durga’s wedding, and honestly the way dhanush went about writing that was probably my least favourite part of the film. in the moment it was a great shock , and you could KINDA see why muthu would do that and MAAAAYBE kinda see why manickam would (although it’s a bit of a stretch). but it felt like dhanush didn’t know if he wanted to go for a completely out of left field twist, like dhanush’s “my loyalty is with guna” in vada chennai, or if he wanted to show the two brothers slowly being manipulated and then be stuck with the ultimatum when they find out it’s raayan that they’re supposed to kill. idk, i think a linear approach MAY have been a better way to deal with that but that’s jus me. also another moment that i felt was kinda out of character was when manickam asked sekar to be able to talk things out with raayan n sekar STRAIGHT away was like ‘yeah calm come meet me at yard’ as if the WHOLE 15-20 mins prior wasn’t spent on how raaya was struggling to come back to proper health after being STABBED by him. that part felt kinda dumb n it felt like they only did so they could show sethu killing him and to give sekar’s character a conclusion. also i thought prakash raj’s character was almost unnecessary in this movie?? i was excited to see him in the film but he had almost no screen time and he just dipped in near the beginning of the film n then completely disappeared until the end? i was hoping we’d go further with his character but wtvr. also final complaint 😭😭 cos i’m lowkey going on for ages now but i felt like the entire adungaatha asuran sequence (great song btw) was kinda rushed in but also jus out of place cos the entire compromise scene in general felt a little half baked, as in both raaya and sethu clearly don’t trust each other in the slightest, so what makes them wanna do this whole massive celebration and WHERE did all those guys come from?? besides those criticisms its actually a really really good film and i hope u guys all watch it.  also the fight scene in the clinic where sekar n durga fight to protect raaya 😫😫😫😫😫 phenomenal , that was another massive highlights of the film cos i genuinely thought someone would die in that scene. there’s this really big feeling of helplessness and i felt that dhanush is too good of a director to go for the cliche “raaya gains superpowers and gets out bed and kills everyone”, so i really didn’t know how they’d get out of that encounter alive. and raaya n durga working together to kill the last guy was 🤤🤤. OH YEAH and the climax fight again bro the way that at first the cameras fixed in one place only showing durai and his goons and you can only HEAR what’s going on outside, that was SOOOO well made. and everyone thinks it’s just raayan who’s fighting but then when ALL THREE COME OUT???? YOOOOOOO it was like that one avengers assemble moment at the end of captain miller but actually good. bro that frame where all 3 brothers r stood together covered in blood is SO FUCKING HARD !!!! fuckin hell man. sorry another super long review

Name: Raayan
Review:
i need to start watching new movies instead of rewatching the same movies over n over again also i will move out of my obsceney long and formal review phase one day have some faith  we haven’t gone to the movies as a family in the long time cos my dad likes watching movies at home on tamilgun more , but for some reason this movie really got my dad hyped up and even though i was reluctant to see the film again, cos i didn’t wanna sit through the second half again, just to go with my parents i booked the tickets. (with my own FUCKING money i hate having a job)  i was writing this review in my head before i’d even gone into the cinema; i was expecting a rewatch to make the glaring flaws of the second half even more obvious, ESPECIALLY the final 20 minutes. BUT ! bro the second time made the movie feel SOOO much better because rather than revelling in the novelty of a dhanush-directed action movie starring himself, you get more time to notice the smaller details and appreciate the masterful filmmaking that dhanush puts on screen here. (ok masterful might be a stretch)  i think this film’s biggest strength, better than the ARR score and better even than the powerhouses dhanush and SJS, is the meticulously crafted visual storytelling at play here. ok i had like a whole list of cool things i wanted to talk ab but am feeling super duper lazy 
spoilers from now on 😄😄❌💯‼️🆘⚠️
one of the COOLEST things i noticed in this movie is when dhanush drops the frame rate at 2 very important points during the movie. the first time, is after their parents go missing n they seek refuge in the priests home. when they get caught by the priest and he takes the aruvaal (lowkey don’t think thats the name), from that moment until after he cuts his throat everything is playing at like 10fps or something and you don’t realise the purpose of this until the second time that it happens, which is the fight scene where he collets the gold from that shop (or sells the gold idk i kinda forgot) for his sisters wedding, n at the end where all the goons team up to fight him. here again the frame rate drops n the only connection between these 2 scenes besides them being fight scenes is, durga ! also this could lowkey be so incorrect n it would be so embarrassing for me but when i clocked this in the cinema i genuinely felt so smart so let me land 😭😭😭. the priest fight hes quite literally trying to save durga’s life and the second time hes protecting the money needed to run the wedding itself, and i think thats a really creative and subtle way to show the unconditional love and care raaya has for durga, in a way that isn’t completely in your face. i thought that was soooo smartly done and made me respect dhanush and om prakash so much more, altho this theory does kinda fall apart cos you’d expect the frame rate to drop again at the fight where durga’s kidnapped in sethu’s wife’s yard just before his brother betray him. but we’ll jus ignore that ☠️☠️.  also i really liked there’s soooo many back shots of raaya pause where u can only see the back of his head n it completely hides what emotions he’s feeling. i thought ir really added to the whole mysterious, cold hearted character that dhanush was trying to build and again using visual hints like that rather than just saying it out loud (which they did a lot too, but still) made the movie so much more interesting and gave it a lot of replay value too.  i still thought that after the compromise scene the movie plot-wise falls a lot BUT there were these 2 shots that were BARE cool and distracted me from the otherwise disappointing ending. first there was the shot right after durga stabs the younger brother, and her n raaya walk backwards into the smoke n like FADE OUT SLOWLY BRO THAT SHIT WAS SO COOL and then way after when raaya comes back to the festival area , u can see the ten heads like at the gate entrance but then as he comes out of the smoke the ten heads r ATTACHED to him and slowly fade out BRO WHAT THE FUCK I LOOOOVE THIS MOVIE !!!! something similar happens when durga kills guna n the crowd cheered a lot for those 2 scenes but lowkey idk much ab the ramayana story so i didn’t fully get it. anyways im gonna start yapping again if i dont stop soooooo super banger !!! also watched longlegs n it was hard need to write a review for that next

Name: Sapta Sagaradaache Ello – Side A
Review:
was ABSOLUTELY not expecting to cry cos of this movie 

niki recommended this movie like 300 times and i was SO CONVINCED it was gonna be meady but my gosh 😭😭😭😭😭

you can’t talk about this movie without acknowledging the INCREDIBLE score and soundtrack by charanraj. i think if there was a hierarchy of what makes a film work, music is EASILY in the top 3 most important aspects, and it has never been more apparent than in this film. every significant point in this film is accompanied by a beautiful score that elevates the emotions you’re feeling tenfold. the composer was also great at knowing when NOT to add any music, to emphasise what certain characters are feeling at some of the most pivotal points of the movie. you can forgive bad visuals but poor audio can almost always RUIN an otherwise good movie, so i’m glad that wasn’t a worry with this. 

another MASSIVE strength of the movie is the 😍😍😍 cinematography and editing. there’s beautiful match cuts like when the car transitions into the leaf flowing through the river, or OMG there’s this one scene near the ending, when they’re showing the parallels between priya getting married and manu beating the FUCK out of soma. (the entire sequence is an incredible example of how good editing can tell a story, i was in awe during that entire part) when they’re pouring the seeds or something into the fire at the wedding, n then it cuts to at a prison n the SEEDS ARE STILL THERE AND HE FUCKING PUNCHES THOUGH THEM OMG 😍😍😍 bro that’s FUCKING CINEMA WTF !!!! that was probably my favourite bit of the entire movie but there’s so many other small details like that which make the movie SO fun to watch, you can absolutely tell that the entire crew put their everything in this movie. 

anyway manu and priya 🥰🥰🥰 they’re so cute that is genuinely pissed me off bro WHEN IS IT MY TURN !! the chemistry between was 10000% believable, the writers did a fantastic job making their relationship feel real, and this was especially apparent in the second half when he’s in prison when they kept putting in little snippets and flashback to their relationship; they were just frequent enough that it makes you feel the same anguish that manu does and even YOU start to feel the pain of their separation. but it was also not so frequent that it took away from the loneliness that manu was feeling being stuck there. i think the way they handled showing how manu missed priya was genuinely perfect. 

also rakshit and rukmini are the centre of this whole journey and they couldn’t be more likeable; they were given a phenomenal script and they PERFORMED IT EVEN BETTER. i was like “yeah they’re p good actors” during the first 30 mins when they were being all cutesy with the kathe and 🤞🏽 but after they got separated it’s like they both LOCKED IN and gave in INCREEEEDIBLE performances. God im so bad at writing i literally don’t know what else to say but everytime priya was at home and she just could NOT act normal it was SO relatable and SO believable and you couldn’t help but feel so so sad for her. i loved that comparison they made between manu physically being stuck between four walls and priya mentally being in a prison despite all the freedom she physically has, there were just so many clever metaphors in the movie and i can’t wait to watch it again. rakshit also was absolutely absolutely amazing. you can tell that he’d do ANYTHING for priya, the fact he even considered doing time just to buy them a house, you don’t even think twice about it because it just FEELS natural for something that these characters would do. you completely understand why priya was mad (even i was , y didn’t he just run it by her in advance 😭😭) but at the same time you could also understand manu’s desperation; it’s hard to say anyone was absolutely wrong for any decision they made in the entire film. id say that goes for ANYONE in the film; soma, as much of a prick as he was you can’t blame him for taking advantage of manu, he’s been stuck there for God knows how long. prabhu? acc nvm he was a prick thru and thru all of the rich guys were 

in my opinion the best part of the whole film was when manu decides that priya should move on, after realising he’s gonna have to serve 10 years. AHHH WAIT MAN NO the whole thing w the tape was also another amazing addition especially when you realise thats why it’s called side A and side B lmao i laughed a bit when i clocked that. anyway the whole thing with this 90 minute audio recording being at that point the most important thing in his life, the struggle priya went through mentally to even record it, that whole subplot was so so so well done i loved it. and the escape attempt too that part i was ACTUALLY nervous too especially when they stopped the water tank. BRO IM JUST GONNA RECAP THE MOVIE WTF THE WHOLE MOVIE IS SICK BASICALLY 

anyway im a sucker for GUT wrenching stories with like zero hope at all (that’s y i loved last of us 2 so much lmao) and everything after manu sends the letter telling her to move on just like a rocket launcher + 800 billion bullets to the heart and i could FEEL  a lump building in my throat. but i was like nah i can firm this but OMG then they showed priyas reaction and they showed her turning up to visiting hours n manu not coming and i COULDNT HELP IT I JUST KEPT CRYING 😭😭😭😭 i think it’s the hardest cried for any movie potentially more than 96 which is absolutely wild 

i watched side b straight after (accidentally did an all nighter fuck sake) review coming soon !! anyway yeah the movie is absolutely amazing you should watch it i can tell y niki loves it sm ☠️☠️

Name: Sapta Sagaradaache Ello - Side B
Review:
💔

longest review of all time my bad 

like i said in side a i watched this STRAIGHT after finishing side a, after a little bit of debating cos it was THREE AM. but i decided there probably wasn’t any better way to watch the movie than as a double bill, especially cos the events of the first films will be so prominent in my mind. considering both movies were filmed at the same time it just felt right (at least i think anyway cos of the trailer at the end of side a) 

the best parts of side a were the phenomenal soundtrack and BEAUTIFUL visuals, and in side b it’s like they turned the dial up to 800 BILLION cos ITS SOMEHOW EVEN BETTER IN SIDE B!!! specifically the cinematography. the music was on par with side a’s (and the songs weren’t as good n its so annoying they never released the full album on streaming) but my LORD. 

MY LOOOOOOOOORD THE VISUALS are genuinely 10x better than the already stunning imagery from side a. bro im acc a SLUT for good looking movies n this GENUINELY is in like top 5 most good looking movies ive ever seen. bro i acc cant talk ab this without actually like tweaking its like the prison-marriage match cut i talked ab at the end of side a but just BARE times throughout the movie. sorry bro let me actually compose myself im acc bare excited to talk ab how this movie looks. if you’ve read ANY review for this film you’ve heard ab the ‘mirror shot’ n i was expecting it to just be a interesting shot like those in VTK (i dont acc remember what it looked like i just remember there being a lot of mirrors in that movie) but i did NOT EXPECT THAT !!!! at first i thought they were talking about when surabhi’s on the bed but in the mirror you see priya, n i was like YOO THATS SICK WTF cos there’s actually a huge storytelling element to that which is also very very subtle as the movie directs all your attention to the bed, and despite being technically very easy to recreate, it’s still VERY creative and another example of the incredible detail Rao put into creating this movie. I also love how surabhi actually looks a tiny bit similar to priya, maybe i’m tweaking but i’m PRETTY sure when surabhi was walking up the stairs when manu first sees her, they actually did swap her out for priya BUT I CANT TELL. SORRY IM WAFFLING AGAIN anyway i thought that bedside mirror scene was the one everyone was raving about and i was very satisfied, BUT THEN !!!!!!! 😍🤯😍🤯😍🤯😍🤯😍😍🤯😍 

BOTH OF THEM IN THE SAME MIRROR????? HOW GREEEEEDY 😭😭 no like that was genuinely insane and SO unnecessary but SOOOOOO well executed and good looking and visually striking and interesting and beautiful and like 😍😍 i fr had to pause the movie there and deeped theyre acc not playing around w this second instalment bro this is FUCKING CINEMA 😭. anyway besides those 2 shots n another incredible one ill talk about later, jus the colour grading in general is visually so pleasing to look at. a highlight for me was in that bar that manu kept meeting deepak at, especially when they look back at that like cubicle or phone room or like ?? idk what it was but that little section of yellow light, the whole room was jus lit so well everything was great to look at. man i could go on and on for example when manu was chasing kali thru the train tracks, BEAUTIFUL imagery and even BETTER when kali thinks he’s lost him but then YOU SEE HIS SILHOUETTE SLOWLY RISE FROM THE TREES ?!?!?? WITH RHAT MUSIC TOO??? HOLY 😍 

ok time to acc talk ab the story cos i could go on about how beautiful this movie looks by dissecting every single frame but let me acc pattern 

the whole premise of side b as well is exactly my cup of tea; a man comes out of prison after TEN years still haunted by his past love and goes on a journey to get her back. 😮‍💨😮‍💨 that’s a fucking story and a half dude let’s go ! and the first hour really WAS very interesting. slower paced than side a sure, but it brings you into the mind of manu and (importantly) DOES NOT PAINT HIM AS A HERO !!! (animal 🤮🤮). as an outsider looking in, the things he’s doing is creepy and stalking and there’s no two ways about it; however after you’d just spent the past 140 minutes living with him and seeing him slowly lose the love of his life to a series of increasingly unfortunate events, you just can’t help but feel sorry for him. like WHAT do you mean priya has a husband and a FUCKING KID??? AND A SEVEN YEAR OLD ONE TOO?? BRO SHE MOVED ON SO QUICK 😭😭 (but not priyas fault at all im happy that she did.) you can feel manu’s desperation and that dream sequence???? bro that actually actually actually broke my heart so bad. that whole portion of the film felt super relatable and AGAIN I REALISE that it is by all means weird and unhealthy behaviour but like poor guy man. guy hasn’t felt any type of affection in ten years and the only type of affection that he has any memory of is from priya; and after living a life devoid of organic social interactions you wouldn’t expect him to understand HOW weird what he’s doing is. anyway the first hour is a great example of the life of a broken and haunted man but i also did really like the inclusion of surabhi, she was funny and unique and had great chemistry with manu, i wouldn’t have minded if the direction they decided to take was manu moving on and marrying surabhi. but im also happy they did decide to tell THIS story. side a felt like a journey through these characters lives but side b’s more over the top presentation felt more like a movie, if that makes any sense

however, for some reason i felt myself losing interest at multiple times through the movie. i was doing an all nighter so it rly could jus be me being super tired in the second half of the movie so i AM going to rewatch it, but it felt like there was SO much stuff happening but at the same time the plot wasn’t really going anywhere? idk if that makes any sense but it felt like the second half was just like “this happened , also this happened , oh yeah this too” rather than there being a natural flow from one event to the next. but again maybe i was just tired and im chatting so much poo rn. rakshit was again a BRILLIANT actor, i felt so sorry for him the entire time and even tho the circumstances make you feel that anyways, his performance elevated it so much more. when he was eating the munch priya made for her kid?? 😢😢 especially when they flashbacked to when he ate it at prison, cos there were a lot of times priya tried to give him food but couldnt, made that moment feel much more significant. 

anyway i’ve been waffling for bare long now im p sure this is alr longer than side a review and i didn’t even enjoy the movie nearly as much 😭😭 but i NEED to talk about one more thing. that FUCKING LONGTAKE AT SOMA’s LAIR?!?!?! one of my favourite moments of each movie, so a film like this, where the entire plot is around this topic should’ve been perfect for me. but why didn’t it work out for me?  the movie i find this most similar to is 96. 2 childhood sweethearts reconnecting after an incredibly long time, where one of them is married and one of them is just unable to move on. but in 96 i was rooting for them to succeed so bad, in past lives a part of me was almost hoping they didn’t work out. it’s not at all to do with the performances or the way the two leads were shown tho cos their chronic regret and love for each other was absolutely believable; i couldn’t help but feel bad for sung in every single scene, constantly stuck in this cycle of “what if it had worked out”, that too across 24 long years. but i think making the husband present through out the entire film made it so difficult for me to, idk bro difficult to root for anyone or WANT a certain event to happen. like in 96 i WANTED jaanu to not board that flight, i WANTED her to cheat on her husband, cos i didn’t KNOW who he was. i didn’t know her kids, i didn’t know how their relationship was, nothing. and i think the fact you didn’t know anything about her life that she’s living at home made it much easier to root for ram and jaanu to work out cos you don’t even THINK about the fact she has her own life now. to be completely fair it’s not like it’s good that i’m rooting for her to leave her husband and kids behind and that conflict is probably (tbf it literally is) one of the central themes of this movie but i just , i’m not interested in that yk? tbh i think i just went into this movie being very very close minded cos im realising now that the movie very clearly is NOT trying to make you root for nora and sung to work out , but the entire first half of the film feels like it’s trying to do just that. i guess it’s just being realistic? like if my childhood chellam came back into my life but she had a boyfriend it’s entirely unrealistic for her to cheat on him but like. it’s a movie yk i wanted to live in this fantasy world where the hopeless romantics end up winning. idek what im tryna say bro i guess the movie just didn’t go the direction i wanted it to go and that’s absolutely not the makers fault it jus wasn’t the movie for me  however the movie is absolutely absolutely gorgeous. sounds phenomenal aswell im listening to the soundtrack rn n it’s literally making me reminisce about every talking stage ive ever had lmaoooo whats wrong w me bra. everytime i felt myself losing interest there would be the most beautiful shot of all mankind on screen n it would hook me again. the entire ferry scene was soooooo nice to look at. but yeah idk not a fan. again such a super duper beautiful movie tho maybe this warrants a rewatch when im in a mature place. idk .

Name: La La Land
Review: bro what else can i say about this movie that i haven't already loool was feeling like a nice romance movie tn n what better option is there 😍 im also listening to the director's commentary rn and there's so much stuff that i cant believe i've never caught before; like the fact that when mia's at the restaurant with greg and his brother and she hears mia n seb's theme playing, it's not ACTUALLY playing, it's just happening in her head because she's thinking about seb that entire time. the whole first hour of this film is genuinely the hardest i've smiled at any movie ever and the happiest i've been for like 2 weeks asw that's kinda depressing to say 😭 anyway the chemistry between ryan and emma is one of the several pillars that make this film what it is; i don't know what other actor i could cast for mia and seb who would be AS believable as these two. right from their first little meetcute the slight awkward tension between them feels so realistic and this is at its peak when they're at the lighthouse and he asks to take her to the rialto, and he stutters bares when he asks her out. the planetarium sequence is also so well done, and allowing the entire scene to be score allows the actors to show off their body language and expressions, that whole scene is incredible man. the summer montage, even after you know how the movie ends is still so fun to watch, all these little snippets of how happy the pair are together, you can't help but fall in love with their relationship. i love all the places they go to asw a lot of my boxd friends are from LA n i cant believe you man actually LIVE here thats crazy 😭 . the city of stars duet was also SOO painful cos of the whole flash forward during the song, showing us the slow deteroriation of their relationship, and then bringing us back to them still in their 'honeymoon phase'. its painful because when we return back to the present you can see the pure love and innocence in each other's faces, but you the viewer are now aware of the direction the film's about to go in. incredibly well written scene imo. 'start of fire' is lowkey a meady song compared to the rest of the soundtrack but its one of emma stone's more significant scenes. it really subtly shows the change in their dynamic, that too with absolutely no dialogue; entirely though close ups of emma's face. each close up after seb starts playing, and she realises that the music he's playing goes against a lot of what seb was telling mia earlier in the movie, is SOOOO well done, both in emma's acting and a lot of the camera work. emma shows the subtle jealousy/disappointment really well, and then the camerawork showing her being pushed further away from seb by the fans also shows the drifting between the two characters really cleverly. FALL anyway after that we finally get to the 'green scene', 💔 faaaaaaack man . i saw a tiktok once that compares the script to what the actors actually said and in the commentary they said that they actually cross shot the scene to let them improvise, and im so glad they did that. all the deviations from the script felt natural and felt like the right thing to say, imo it was moment in the movie that the actors were most in character. apparently the "you're an actress" , "you don't get it" all those super sly jabs weren't even in the script but they're arguably some of the most pivotal lines of the whole argument, again it speaks to how good these performers are. the entire film after the city of stars duet changes from the sort of super stylised fantastical theatre to more of a realistic drama. the fast pace, wild moving camera, beautiful music all comes to a standstill in this scene. it's entirely ryan and emma who carry this scene through to the end. and the painful part is that you can't exactly say either person is wrong. all the shots are static close ups, and stay that way for the duration of the scene. the tension in this scene is shown super well and tears down the idyllic fantasy land we were living through for the past 60 minutes in such a painful way. and every single scene after that becomes more and more hard to get through. in the messengers photoshoot you can see seb start to show on his face that he feels like he doesn't belong, and mia's play flopping as well everything just comes crashing down and you really start to get the idea that there might not be a happy ending for this movie 😭. i feel like im lowkey jus recapping the movie my bad guys yk im so poo at writing reviews. WINTER after seb gets the call from amy brandt casting there's a tiiiny glimmer of hope in their relationship, we see them talking again and you see seb encouraging her, callilng back to the house in front of the library, taking her to the audition, the conversation on the hill near the planetarium, it's all just a massive mixed bag of emotions and you get this hint that they might try work together to look beyond the past but at the same time you can also sense that the vibes between them feel incredibly different to how it was an hour earlier in the movie. and i cant FUCKING believe that they go from the convo on the hill STRAIGHT TO 5 YEARS LATER??? WTF i could’ve sworn there was more scenes in between 😭😭😭😭😭😭 i kinda like how they cut sooo far forward and when you see her back in LA again you have another tiny glimmer of hope. maybe im just too much of a hopeless romantic but i genuinely believed that it would be seb waiting for her at home and not that other meady old don. also apparantly the audition was done completely live that's kinda crazy emma has PIPES on her fam. anyway then the iconic epilogue plays, and it's so so so so SO heartbreaking. a 6 minute montage showing the life seb wanted to live with mia, revisiting so many of the significant places the two went to earlier in the film, revisiting each pivotal moment but as if everything had gone right. it's a crushing "what could've been" montage and u guys know that's one of my fav things to think about loool . seeing her walk into the club and seeing he left the "chicken on a stick" name for mia's suggestion, n then the pause seb takes when he notices her in the crowd, it's all sooooo sad and so well acted too. the fact the transition to the alternate reality happens WHILST he's playing mia n seb theme too?? fuuuuuck man. i hope seb gets the happy ending he deserves pause i was gonna talk about the music n colours n stuff but thinking about the epilogue lowkey made me too sad to keep on writing 😭 the music's probably the single most important aspect of the film imo, it carries so much emotion and nearly every song in the soundtrack is in my top 100 this year. and the grading is soooo beautiful , and it being shot on film lends a lot to the vibe the film tries to create. the natural grain and halation everything its just soooo beautiful. i love this movie man. i kinda wanna get the steelbook of it just to have it but its £40 thats acc so ridiculous especially when i hsve a 4k print of it anyway 😭 bro i downloaded a 78gb print of this film lmao that was so unnecessary anyway beautiful movie but i’ve never cried to it idk why, it’s absolutely heartbreaking and the relationship feels relatable and personal to me but i think im not as able to relate to the whole career aspiration conflict part of the story cos im super lazy and not ambitious at all. 96’s complete focus on longing and yearning for someone from your past feels much more in line with my personal character bro i sound SO PATHETIC LMAOOOO anyway love u thank u for reading 🫶🏽🫶🏽 bro why did i say that at the start of my review n then write my LONGEST review of the movie yet loool

Review: ?  i’m stuck between absolutely despising this ‘film’, and finding it creative and introspective (in a really shit way though)  spoilers ! the films obviously trying to tell a story of child abuse but reversing the roles in an effort to be creative and whilst a lot of the concepts on paper sound, not interesting but unique and thought provoking, the experience of watching the film isn’t really enjoyable in any way at all. of course i don’t think a story about this topic is supposed to be ‘enjoyable’ but it felt like there was no real reason for anyone to watch this film. like you don’t get anything out of it  i do think the sound design was phenomenal, that sort of droning/thumping sound during the middle of the film when sidney’s writing his memoir thing REALLY adds a lot to the tension, and the super loud, blunt footsteps too all these sounds make that moment super nerve wracking. and again in the bathroom when he’s being abused, only showing the audio and leaving the rest to the imagination again it was a clever (i feel so weird using a positive word about the film fucking hell) way to add onto that tension.  nah icl bun reviewing this movie 😭😭😭 so meady and i get that it’s supposed to be shocking but it just felt like “look how edgy and dark my film is 🤯🤯” n all the reviews glazing it n calling it deep r so jarring y am i actually vexed 😭  ok no actually  i will say the mum character was interesting n reflective of real scenarios like this, n this was most apparent during the bathroom scene. i like how there’s also an alternate interpretation where u look at the intro as the son thinking that sidney saying “those feelings are normal” is about the incest thoughts the son has. i like how the memoir thing is labelled confessions, as if to say sidney FAACK BRO THIS MOVIES SO GOOD 😭😭😭 darshanas entire subplot was written really well imo especially when you contrast the potential for arun to cheat with when he actually did cheat w shaun romy, it was a great way to show his growth . i love how mature the movie feels ESPECIALLY their final convo at the beach , when he says that dialogue about how there’s specific times in life that make you realise like this is what you’re living for , it felt like the perfect thing to say at that time but lowkey getting married when ur still slyly in love with ur ex is insane dude her husband is so paavam  not to be super gay but arun was holy lengers in this bro his trim during onakka munthiri is my dream hair !! his acting was amazing too dude he’s soooooo believable the entire way thru. like when he’s going thru his hard man facade after he loses darshana you can SEE his heart’s not in it n i was lowkey worried the movie was gonna become wannabe sandeep ranga movie (pundai director) but i loved his character arc bro. oh yeah SELVA?????  💔💔💔💔 i was told this isn’t cry inducing cinema but FUCK me his death got me close bro , it felt so out of nowhere but then again that is how life goes bro again i love how realistic this film is . icl im reading some of these reviews i didnt realise how much people HATE THIS MOVIE LMAOOOOO maybe im jus easy to please but i didnt find the characters underdeveloped at all . n yes the movie does rely on nostalgia a lot but like 😭😭😭😭😭 who CARES BRO ITS FUN !!! all the scenes where hes reconnecting w his past like when he sees all his malayali friends again or when he goes thru the secret alley had me smiling like a BITCH bro idk why that makes people so mad lmao  what the fuck fam i’m listening to the soundtrack rn this is actually so good also the atmos mix is stunning i wanna try spotify next year but not having atmos is so sad  also this movie gave me mega GVM vibes , w the incredible album and the narration and it being just a retelling of someone’s life , feels a lot like vaaranam aayiram i rly liked it. also arun n nithya relationship so so cute when’s it my turn  i’ve been in my own head a lot recently and for the 3 hours this movie went on for i felt so at peace man i needed a film like this so bad .  ok this review lowkey sucks but i wanna rewatch this movie so bad n write a proper REAL review like my 96 one that’s acc my favourite review ever ever bro

jesse’s a stronger man than me bro if that was me i would’ve cried and killed myself 17 times

i love rewatching movies that i didn’t like the first time i watched them , this was such a cute movie and im glad i revisited it . i wasn’t expecting to like it cos it’s literally ENTIRELY dialogue but it’s FLIPPING GOOD WRITING bro

‘insecurities’ or fears or whatever i’ve done that a couple times before it’s so cute

also their chemistry is ridiculous bro . i alr spoke ab the dialogue but even physically all their expressions and their slight nervousness talking to each other and their quick glances at each other like in the listening booth aaaaaa its so cute man . 

these one takes are RIDICULOUS btw bro that tram scene was like SIX MINS LONG BRO ZEEEROOOO CUTS???? that’s FUCKED bro i’m lowkey repeating myself bares but at times it felt like they were jus improvising their lines like it didn’t even feel like written dialogue

being from eelam i was never really aware of the prevalence of the indian caste system, or how cruel it is even in the modern day. however being from eelam again i still felt like i could resonate with the oppression mari selveraj showed in the movie (not thru me, more so what my parents and grandparents have faced). 

i’ve never been able to understand symbolisms and stuff in movies i dont consider myself that smart but the significance of the colour blue really interested me and i started researching more about the caste system because of it

i know now that the colour represents the dalit struggle (kathir’s low caste) and more specifically dr ambedkar, who started the entire revolution for dalit rights in the country. i love that the movie explicitly mentions him asw when pariyan’s applying for that college. it being the colour of the party ambedkar founded was suuuuch a good choice man i really love all the subtler details in the film that stop it from feeling preachy/manipulative. anyways anyways im yapping the symbolism with the colour blue reaches its peak during the ‘naan yaar’ video; a look into pariyan’s mind after the confrontation at the wedding . comparing him and the way society views him to small animals, showing him trapped onto a chair, isolated in all these different places there’s so much messaging in that little video that i would never be able to decipher. the cuts to all the other several unnamed victims of the caste system, all with the same blue marks on them, and then of course his ‘protective spirit’, karuppi’s ghost. i also loved that the colour blue starts to become much more prevalent in the cinematography, for example kathir starts wearing blue clothes, blue walls in many of the rooms he’s in, i found it such a smart way to connect kathir’s struggle to a much more massive historical fight for justice. goodness this film’s so well done

the naivety of the upper castes (hi niki 🤨 #oppressor) is also shown so well. i like how pariyan called jyo his ‘one ray of hope for humanity’ and the teacher still didn’t understand what he meant, i think it highlighted really well the privilege upper caste members have so much so that they can’t even understand the reasons behind pariyan’s anger. even when he’s brought into the office again with his real father and the principal has that entire speech about rising against the oppression and becoming someone great despite his circumstances, the teacher says “why’d u jus let him go why didn’t u suspend him, he’s gonna fight the other kids” even after it’s literally spelled out to her she still doesn’t understand why he feels that way, and is even tryna protect the other kids rather than helping out pariyan. and even jyo’s character has at times an annoying level of obliviousness to why her brother treats him that way, constantly saying he’s just picking fights with him for no reason. or that one scene at the start where she was getting picked on by the senior’s and the stopped when they realised she was one of the upper castes too, but she didn’t even tell them. (maybe it was cos she’s ignorant of the whole caste system or maybe im reaching lol) i feel like mari selveraj was tryna show the ignorance of even the well-meaning people of upper caste, and shows that having good intentions isn’t always enough to make a real change, you need to truly understand the systemic issues behind castes to even begin to truly empathise with pariyan. i think making it the teacher, who’s supposed to be the more intellectual person in this scenario, the ignorant one was a really good choice too.

jyo’s father was a really well written character too cos whilst he is still a villain, he has a small level of aversion to violence, but isn’t entirely against it when he needs to protect his character and honour. he has more fear over his caste mates murdering jyo for hanging out with pariyan than he does a personal hatred for pariyan. i think that was a great way to show that even in the upper caste there are people who WANT to be good, but are in a way, restricted by the expectations society has of them as an upper caste. although it’s not in the same way, even jyo’s father is somewhat oppressed. 

also one more thing i loooooved the final shot, showing that there is some kind of solidarity/equality between the two thru the cups. earlier in the movie there was that one scene comparing the cup pariyan was drinking from to the ones that upper castes were using, and i think bringing that back to show them now using the same cups was a smart way to kinda show the barriers being broken down in a way yk. its a small step but its something nonetheless.

ok serious review over hope u guys liked it 😍😍😍 was i cooking?????? 

anyway i wanted to go one review without gaaji rath but bro. anandhi. i know i say this a lot but this time i REALLY MEAN IT BRO ANANDHI IS THE BIGGEST CRUSH I HAVE ON ANY ACTOR EVERRRRRRRRRRR bro shes SO GORGEOUS 😭 lowkey the first 25 mins ish where it was bare cutie putie i was struggling to lock in cos i kept getting distracted by how unbeliavably azahgu she was fam FAAAACK I LOVE HER 😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍 

also the music. santhosh narayanan 😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭😭 my fav musician man I LOVE HIM !!!!!!!!!!! 
he’s been my fav ever since 2022 (sometimes tied w ARR) but i just love the more folk and jazz inspired instruments he uses, all his songs feel so different to the rest of kollywood’s soundtracks. mahaan imo is one of the best tamil albums in a loooong time, bro rich rich n evanda enakku custody?????
